create_api_vlm_model: create an ApiVlmModel instance with enabled flag, remote services permission, and VLM pipeline options
run_vlm_page_batch: run the ApiVlmModel to process a batch of document pages through a remote VLM API with concurrency
configure_vlm_options: configure ApiVlmOptions with URL, timeout, concurrency, prompt, scale, and max_size for VLM inference
test_api_vlm_model: test the ApiVlmModel raises OperationNotAllowed when remote services are disabled but model is enabled
review_api_image_request: review how api_image_request sends page images to a remote VLM endpoint and stores predictions on Page objects
